existing_terminology: Not established from the sources consulted. No Lao term for a childhood language disorder was found, and no category that a child with DLD would fall into. The UNESCO PEER profile for Lao PDR reports that "A definition of special education needs has not been found", and the operational definition it does record — from the 2011-15 National Strategy and Plan of Action on Inclusive Education — is built from social groups (girls and women, ethnic children, learners with disabilities, remote populations), not from types of impairment. A peer-reviewed 2020 account of cleft-palate speech services states there is no speech-language pathologist profession in the country, which is consistent with no clinical vocabulary having been settled. Searched: the UNESCO PEER Lao PDR inclusion profile, the 2020 IJPORL paper and its PubMed record, and general web search for speech and language therapy terminology and services in Lao PDR.
